title.zh: Stripe与Plasma合作开发多币种稳定币卡，拟降低跨境换汇成本
title.en: Stripe与Plasma合作开发多币种稳定币卡，拟降低跨境换汇成本

current_state.zh: Stripe is partnering with Plasma to develop multi-currency stablecoin cards that let individuals and businesses spend directly in currencies they already hold, cutting FX conversion costs across a payment network set to expand from 30+ to 100+ countries by 2027.
